verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections locally on the user's filesystem with no cloud sync, account, or telemetry, effectively giving users full control over where their data resides (their own machine or self-hosted git remote) rather than a formal region-selection feature. This satisfies the residency/control intent but there's no explicit multi-region or data-center choice mechanism since no cloud service exists at all. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or documentation, enterprise data-residency certifications, or cloud-hosted storage options with regional controls.
